statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The condition is diagnosed under I48.0, I48.91, and R55
Correlating symptoms with arrhythmic activity requires continuous monitoring during daily activities
The telemetry was ordered to capture rhythm data during daily activities so clinical events can be correlated with arrhythmic activity
The denial reason code is PR-204
